name: Rollback
purpose: Return production to the last known good version and prove it is healthy.
trigger: A production release fails verification, or a Sev1 regression is traced to the latest release.
entry_criteria: Last known good artifact version identified

steps.note: Confirm the rollback plan matches what was actually deployed.
Only if the failed release changed the schema or data.
Redeploy the last known good artifact.

decisions.question: Did the failed release change the database?

failure_paths.condition: Smoke test fails on the rolled-back version
failure_paths.action: Escalate to incident-response; consider rolling back one more version
Stop; DBA owner and incident commander choose forward-fix or restore from backup

exit_criteria: Production runs the last known good version
Smoke test and health checks pass
Failed release version blocked from redeploy
communication_plan: Announce rollback start and completion in the incident channel; notify affected customers if the failure was user visible.
